ns2:section.sectionText: Reading with Roland Barthes. This graduate seminar explores the work of Roland Barthes (1915-1980), one of the most influential literary critics of the twentieth century. We will read Barthes’s major critical works along with some the key literary texts he examines (by Balzac, Zola, Michelet, Loti and others). We will consider Barthes’s engagement with (as well as his influence on) critical approaches including Semiotics, Structuralism and Poststructuralism, Photography Studies, and Affect Studies. Taught in French.
